_comment: Podcast Reference Profile v1.0 — first concrete ReferenceProfile for Creator OS
_authority: Byrne et al. 1994 JASA DOI:10.1121/1.410152 (LTASS); ITU-R BS.1770-5 (2018); EBU R128 v5.0; Apple Podcasts art.893

hard_constraints._comment: Absolute limits — never violated by ReferenceResolver (INV-REF-1). Sources: ITU-R BS.1770-5 (2018), EBU R128 v5.0, Apple Podcasts art.893.
hard_constraints._lra_note: Measured parameter, soft target only — not a hard spec (EBU Tech 3342). 7 LU is typical for dialogue.

spectral_target._comment: Normalised SHAPE only (mean=0, relative dB). NOT absolute dBFS levels — see spec Correction 1: Byrne values are dBSPL, used for shape only. Method: convert dBSPL to linear energy, average per band, convert back to dB, subtract mean.

bands.label: Treble
bands._source: Derived: Band[5] (-5.49 dB) minus 4 dB/oct spectral tilt. Tilt range -3 to -5 dB/oct above 800Hz per Byrne LTASS analyses (Spec §13). Midpoint -4 dB/oct chosen for determinism. NOT a direct Byrne measurement.
bands._note: 0.0 rejected — hiss trap: resolver would boost room noise and sibilance to spectral mean

bands.label: Air
bands._source: Derived: Band[6] (-9.49 dB) minus 4 dB/oct spectral tilt. Same tilt methodology as Band[6].
bands._note: Voice has negligible energy above 8kHz — falling target prevents destructive Air boost

sbr._comment: Spectral Balance Ratio bands. Both within Byrne data range — Correction 2 does not apply to SBR band selection. Measures articulation (1-2kHz) vs mud (500-1kHz): the defining delta for podcast voice quality.

noise_floor._source: Internal design choice — no international standard codifies this value (Spec §3.1, INV-REF-5)
